item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
Issued at 05:42 AM 20 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OccidentalMindoro(AbraDeIlog and SantaCruz) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OccidentalMindoro(Paluan and Mamburao) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
